title: Green Horizon Officially Launched Under Erasmus+ Youth Programme
author: Consortium Secretariat
summary: Integrational e.V. (Germany), IESA (Türkiye), and Asociația Empower Plus (Romania) commence a 16-month initiative empowering young Europeans through aerial technology and environmental digital media.
content:
On 1 May 2025, the 'Green Horizon: Youth Voices for Climate Action Through Drone Technology' project officially began its implementation period under the Erasmus+ KA210-YOU Small-scale Partnerships in Youth scheme.

Over the course of 16 months (May 2025 – August 2026), the transnational partnership will bridge the critical intersection between advanced digital technologies and climate activism. By equipping youth workers, educators, and young participants with theoretical and hands-on skills in drone piloting, environmental aerial photography, and cinematic storytelling, Green Horizon fosters a new generation of informed ecological communicators.

The consortium kicks off with its first Transnational Project Meeting in Bonn, Germany, laying down the quality assurance framework and safety protocols that will underpin all upcoming international activities.

title: Transnational Training Course: Preparing Youth Leaders in Aerial Media
author: Training Committee
summary: Partner organisations finalize the safety and pedagogical syllabus for the upcoming summer transnational training course on drone operations and non-formal climate education.
content:
A high-standard curriculum is currently being finalized for the Transnational Drone Operation, Photography, and Video Editing Training Course scheduled for Summer 2025.

The training will bring together 15 youth leaders and youth workers from Germany, Türkiye, and Romania. Participants will undergo rigorous European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) Open Category flight safety orientations, practice manual and automated flight modes, and learn how to collect verifiable visual data on regional environmental degradation.

Graduates of the training course will subsequently spearhead the local youth workshops in their home countries.

title: Editorial Framework Established for Green Horizon Educational Booklet
author: IESA Educational Team
summary: Curriculum architects at IESA and partner organisations unveil the thematic structure for the upcoming open-access handbook for educators.
content:
To ensure long-term sustainability across the European youth education sector, the consortium has defined the 6-module architecture for the 'Green Horizon Educational Booklet: Drones & Climate Storytelling'.

The booklet will be published as an open-access digital guide in English, with key modular summaries in German, Turkish, and Romanian. It will provide educators with plug-and-play workshop lesson plans, legal flight checklists, and case study scripts directly adaptable to classroom and non-formal youth club settings.

A public consultation draft will be circulated among selected partner networks prior to final release.

title: Digital Platform Launch: Official Web Portal greenhorizonyou.eu Goes Live
author: Web Operations Team
summary: The central digital hub for the Green Horizon project is deployed, featuring an interactive consortium map, accessible resource repository, and virtual exhibition space.
content:
The official Green Horizon web portal is now live at https://greenhorizonyou.eu. Built to high European digital accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and responsive web design standards, the platform serves as the central showcase for all forthcoming project outputs, including the 360-degree virtual reality exhibition, educational booklet downloads, and youth documentary series.

The platform has been developed with a privacy-first architecture, clear version-controlled deployment protocols, and multilingual capability.
